organization: Missouri University of Science and Technology
summary: Researching machine learning for distributed systems and networking in the Computer Systems & Networking Lab with Dr. Md Arifuzzaman. Current work covers guarded scientific-model orchestration and bounded, telemetry-driven data-movement optimization.

As a backend engineer on a blockchain-based token-trading platform, I worked on trade, user, wallet, and fee-management services; introduced message queues for reliable inter-service communication; added caching to reduce response latency; and implemented two-factor authentication for sensitive trading operations.
